conditional_planning.purpose: Useful prospective plan across all source-positive dates without claiming a proven complete game model

conditional_planning.successLabel: conditional plan based on listed date availability and current checkpoint

entityGuardApplicability.otherEntities: Evaluate only guards actually relevant to that entity. Nonapplicable guards evaluate satisfied; do not invent missing flags.

compatibilityWithObservedReadyActions.calendar.explicitOrdinaryVisitAvailable: Set true only for confirmed input guard result; never convert conditional-with-assumption into explicit fact. Keep candidate eligibility and source assumptions in separate planner result.

compatibilityWithObservedReadyActions.normalConditionalOResult: May schedule source-tagged candidate in conditional-planning mode without assigning explicitOrdinaryVisitAvailable=true in permanent state.

preMatrixTutorialBaseline.whenCheckpointPrecedesMatrix: Return requires_story_progression_to_planning_boundary with boundary Apr21, plus any specifically requested later link-introduction prerequisite. Do not query or replay every prior date. Do not issue a global impossible result.
